text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple developed paragraphs with topic sentences and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a clear overall structure with an introduction, body paragraphs, and a concluding wrap-up."},{"evidence":"\"students wouldn't feel rushed\"; \"teachers would have more time to teach\"; \"school will be out earlier in the summer\"","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay supports its position with several distinct reasons that are each expanded with explanation."},{"evidence":"\"For instance, sometimes we have educational scavenger hunts\"","quality":"specific evidence","description":"The essay uses a concrete example to illustrate and strengthen its claims."},{"evidence":"\"I strongly concur\"; \"beneficial\"; \"in the long run\"","quality":"academic word choice","description":"The essay uses more precise and mature vocabulary suited to formal argumentative writing."},{"evidence":"\"I think that you should allowed\"; \"one and a half hours is added\"; \"which let's them collaborate\"","quality":"grammar control","description":"The essay shows better control of sentence structure and grammatical forms with fewer disruptive errors."},{"evidence":"\"To begin with,\" \"Secondly,\" \"Lastly,\" \"In conclusion\"","quality":"cohesive transitions","description":"The essay uses clearer linking phrases to guide the reader through its points."}]}
